comment: deps-auto: the e2e battery deps.yml runs in shards on GitHub-hosted runners (scripts/ci/battery.cjs). suites = name -> seconds on a runner (2x the desk time until a runner has measured it); skip = cannot run on a public runner (the reason); optional = runs and reports, does not gate (the reason); setup = extra install a suite needs. Refresh after an integrator battery: node scripts/ci/battery.cjs refresh --list <listA> --list <listB> --summary <summary.txt>... (RELEASING.md, Dependency updates). pc = the games (fps) and levels (shots) scripts/ci/pc-battery.sh measures on a desktop GPU.

skip.arch-primitives: two peers on the self-hosted signaling box
skip.error-reports: needs the production origin mapped to the dev server (a hosts-file setup)
skip.game-race: two peers on the self-hosted signaling box (ci.yml: a public runner is not pointed at it)
skip.net-stress: multi-peer stress on the self-hosted signaling box
skip.timeline-export: needs the built app (scripts/serve-build.cjs), not the dev server
